record.paper_title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: How do the existence, multiplicity, and free-boundary phenomena discussed in the paper change when measures are present in the equation, either as source terms or as coefficients of zero-order terms?

evidence.quote: Presence of measures at the equation (not only as a sourcing data but also as coefficients of zero order terms, . . . )

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ ($N\ge 2$) be a bounded domain with smooth boundary, let $0<\gamma<1$, and let $\lambda>0$. Consider singular semilinear elliptic problems of absorption type whose prototype is
$$-\Delta u + \chi_{\{u>0\}}\,u^{-\gamma} = f \quad\text{in } \Omega,\qquad u\ge 0 \text{ in } \Omega,\qquad u=0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega,$$
together with related formulations in which the singular zero-order term may appear with a non-constant coefficient, i.e.
$$-\Delta u + a(x)\,\chi_{\{u>0\}}\,u^{-\gamma} = f \quad\text{in } \Omega,$$
with $a\ge 0$. For such problems, the set $\{u=0\}$ is referred to as the free boundary.

Develop a theory of the above problems when the data are Radon measures rather than functions. Specifically:

(a) (Measure source.) Let $\mu$ be a nonnegative bounded Radon measure on $\Omega$ and replace $f$ by $\mu$. Determine in what sense (e.g., renormalized, entropy, or distributional solutions) and under what assumptions on $\mu$ (absolute continuity with respect to a suitable capacity, concentration on lower-dimensional sets, etc.) the problem admits a nonnegative solution; analyze uniqueness versus multiplicity of solutions; and describe the structure, regularity, non-degeneracy, and Hausdorff dimension estimates of the free boundary $\partial\{u>0\}$ in terms of $\mu$.

(b) (Measure coefficient of the zero-order term.) Allow the coefficient $a$ to be a nonnegative Radon measure $\nu$ on $\Omega$, so that the singular absorption term takes the formal expression $\nu\,\chi_{\{u>0\}}u^{-\gamma}$. Give a rigorous meaning to this term, establish existence (and, where possible, uniqueness or multiplicity) of nonnegative solutions, and study how the support and singular part of $\nu$ influence the location, regularity, and geometric-measure properties of the free boundary.

The problem is to extend the existence, multiplicity, and free-boundary results known in the function-data setting to these two measure-data settings, identifying the optimal classes of measures for which each phenomenon persists.
artifact.category_tag: singular elliptic equations with measure data
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on singular nonlinear elliptic equations with measure data: existence/uniqueness theories (renormalized and entropy solutions) for $-\Delta_p u + H(u)=\mu$ with singular $H$ have been developed (e.g., Oliva–Petitta and subsequent works), and quasilinear equations with measure-valued absorption terms and measure data have been treated. Free-boundary aspects (regularity, non-degeneracy, Hausdorff estimates) are well-studied for function data and have been partially extended, but a complete theory addressing multiplicity and free-boundary structure when measures appear simultaneously as sources and as coefficients of the singular zero-order term remains incomplete.

status_evidence.title: Existence and uniqueness results for possibly singular nonlinear elliptic equations with measure data
status_evidence.snippet: Nonlinear elliptic boundary value problems with possibly singular lower order terms, p-Laplacian, μ a nonnegative bounded Radon measure, H(s) ~ s^{-γ}.
status_evidence.claim: Existence/uniqueness theory for singular nonlinear elliptic equations with measure source data has been developed.

status_evidence.title: Quasilinear elliptic equations involving measure valued absorption terms and measure data
status_evidence.snippet: Quasilinear elliptic equations with measure-valued absorption terms together with measure data.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work treats measures both as data and as coefficients/absorption, partially addressing the proposed extension.

status_evidence.title: Singular elliptic PDEs: an extensive overview
status_evidence.snippet: Comprehensive survey of singular elliptic PDEs of the form -Δu = u^{-γ} and absorption variants.
status_evidence.claim: A 2024 overview shows the field is active with many partial results but still open issues for measure data.

status_evidence.title: Geometric Approach to Nonvariational Singular Elliptic Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp regularity, non-degeneracy and Hausdorff estimates of the free boundary for singular absorption problems.
status_evidence.claim: Free-boundary geometry is well understood in the function-data case, providing a benchmark for measure-data extensions.
